newsitem.title: USA: Security Bank to buy Pacific State Bank.
newsitem.headline: Security Bank to buy Pacific State Bank.

text.p: Security Bank Holding Co said Wednesday that it had entered a definitive agreement to acquire Pacific State Bank in Reedsport.

The acquisition would be accomplished by an exchange of shares of security Bank Holding Co common stock for the outstanding shares of Pacific State Bank common stock, a news release issued by Security Bank said.
The number of shares was not disclosed.
As of March 31, Pacific State Bank had total assets of $52.1 million and deposits of $44.7 million, the release said.
Following the acquisition, which is expected to close in the next few months, Pacific State Bank would operate as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Security Bank Holding Co, the release said.

Under the agreement, two directors of Security Bank Holding Co would be added to the current board of directors of Pacific State Bank, and two current directors of Pacific State Bank would join the board of Security Bank Holding Co, the release said.
